fields.title: Digit-dense passages are planned under the 400-id token cap
fields.description: The chunk planner's `estimateTokens` (`src/reader/modes/narrate/engine/chunkPlan.ts`) counts each digit at its spoken cost (`DIGIT_TOKEN_WEIGHT` 13), so digit-dense passages such as chess notation are planned into chunks under the 400-id cap instead of failing closed. Text without digits is planned as today.
